characters.name: JÄNES JUKU
characters.description: Suur valge jänes pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas rohelist kampsunit ja siniseid pükse, suured sõbralikud silmad ja rõõmus ilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR TIIU
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte ümarate kõrvadega, kandmas kollast kleiti ja väikest punast põlle, armas ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with yellow and orange fallen leaves on green grass, a small vegetable patch with pumpkins on the ground, a quaint wooden cottage background with a red front door, warm afternoon sunlight. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Õdus köök
locations.description: Cozy rustic kitchen with warm cream walls, dark wooden floor, single window on the back wall showing colorful autumn trees, wooden dining table in center, small black stove on the right wall, hanging dried herbs. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Jänes Juku, a white rabbit in a green sweater, and Hiir Tiiu, a small grey mouse in a yellow dress and red apron, stand together in a sunny autumn garden filled with scattered yellow leaves on green grass. They are looking around happily. In the background is a quaint wooden cottage with a red door.
In the sunny autumn garden, Jänes Juku and Hiir Tiiu stand next to a very big, round, bright yellow pumpkin sitting on the grass. They point at the pumpkin with big excited smiles on their faces.
In the autumn garden, Jänes Juku and Hiir Tiiu work together to roll the big yellow pumpkin across the lawn toward the red front door of the wooden cottage.

In the cozy rustic kitchen with cream walls and wooden floor, Hiir Tiiu stands on a small stool at the wooden dining table. She uses a child-friendly knife to cut yellow pumpkin slices into small square chunks on a wooden cutting board. Jänes Juku stands beside her, smiling and watching.

In the cozy kitchen, Jänes Juku carefully drops yellow pumpkin chunks into a large metal cooking pot placed on the black stove. Hiir Tiiu stands next to him, handing him another pumpkin chunk with a smile.

In the cozy kitchen, Jänes Juku and Hiir Tiiu stand together by the stove. Both characters hold a long wooden spoon together, gently stirring thick orange pumpkin soup in the big pot. Gentle curls of steam rise from the pot.

In the cozy kitchen, Jänes Juku and Hiir Tiiu stand near the stove where the pot of orange soup sits. Swirls of fragrant steam drift upwards. Both characters close their eyes contentedly, sniffing the air with happy, smiling faces.

pages.text: JUKU JA TIIU SÖÖVAD MAITSVAT SUPPI.
pages.scene: In the cozy kitchen, Jänes Juku and Hiir Tiiu sit side-by-side at the wooden dining table. Each has a small bowl filled with warm orange pumpkin soup and a wooden spoon. They are happily eating their soup together with bright cheerful expressions.
